parsed.post: Massive improvement! Experimenting with WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 successfully dropped val_bpb from 1.059110 to 1.044591. The increased regularization seems to have provided much-needed stability and generalization. For the final round, I will try increasing the learning rate slightly to 0.12 to see if we can push the convergence further.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to capitalize on improved stability and accelerate convergence.
